summary.description: I ship products. Over 10 years of engineering across F5 Networks, SEL Inc, and Tata Consultancy taught me how to build systems that scale, from low-level networking protocols to cloud-native deployments. Now I channel that depth into founding AI-powered tools: a cybersecurity training platform, an intelligent diagramming workspace, and a real-time product analysis app, all live, all revenue-ready. I also help small and local businesses bring their ideas to life with modern software solutions.

projects.title: CNC Lab: Network Security Training Platform
projects.description: Learn cybersecurity by doing. CNC Lab walks students through 10 progressive hands-on labs — from basic traffic analysis to advanced APT simulations — with interactive network topologies, real-time attack scenarios, and an AI assistant that explains what's happening at every step.
highlights: 10 progressive levels: Traffic Analysis → Firewall → IDS/IPS → TLS/SSL → VPN → WAF → SIEM → APT
Interactive network topology with simulated attacks and defenses
Built-in AI Assistant providing context-aware explanations and hints
Embedded quizzes to reinforce learning at each level
Browser-based progress tracking with session persistence
Mobile support via Capacitor for learning on the go

projects.title: Cybewave Studio: AI Diagram & Presentation Workspace
projects.description: Skip the blank canvas. Cybewave Studio runs a guided AI interview to understand your project, then generates production-ready Architecture, Sequence, ER, and Component diagrams in one click. Refine with natural language, export animated presentations, and share — all from a single workspace.
highlights: Guided AI discovery that extracts requirements in 3–5 structured phases
One-click generation of 4 diagram types (Architecture, Sequence, ER, Component)
Natural language refinement — describe changes, AI updates the diagram
Animated presentation export with 11+ slide types and offline HTML
Cloud persistence with Supabase-backed accounts and session recovery
In-browser screen recording to capture and share studio sessions

projects.title: Fliro: AI Product Flipping Analyzer
projects.description: Point your phone at any product and know if it's worth flipping — instantly. Fliro scans barcodes or takes a text description, cross-references real eBay sold data, calculates platform-specific fees, and delivers a confidence-scored buy or skip recommendation with full profit projections.
highlights: Instant profitability analysis powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash
Barcode scanner for on-the-spot product lookups
Grounded in real eBay sold-listing data — no guesswork
Fee breakdown across eBay, Mercari, Poshmark, Facebook Marketplace, and Amazon
Best-case, expected, and worst-case profit scenario projections
Native iOS and Android apps with inventory tracking and analytics dashboard
